moves.head: Thanksgiving night: Bills beat Chiefs 13-10
moves.plain: Buffalo won a low-scoring game in Orchard Park to move to 10-1. Kansas City falls to 8-3.

moves.head: Eagles edge Cowboys 39-38 in Dallas on Thanksgiving
moves.plain: Philadelphia won by one point at AT&T Stadium. The Eagles are 4-7 and the Cowboys fall to 5-7.

moves.head: Bears beat Lions 39-35 in Detroit on Thanksgiving
moves.plain: Chicago won a shootout at Ford Field to move to 9-2. Detroit drops to 8-3, a game behind the Bears.

moves.head: Eagles lose Saquon Barkley, Dallas Goedert, Cooper DeJean and Marcus Epps during the Cowboys game
moves.plain: Barkley (stinger) did not return, and Goedert (shoulder), Epps (foot) and DeJean (concussion, in the first half) were ruled out during Thursday's game in Dallas. Philadelphia won anyway, but how many of them can play next week is the big question for the offense and the secondary.

moves.head: Bears TE Colston Loveland leaves the Lions game with a knee injury
moves.plain: Loveland was ruled out in the first half of Thursday's win in Detroit. No timeline was given.

moves.head: Seahawks rule out OT Abraham Lucas and G Quenton Nelson for Sunday against the 49ers
moves.plain: Lucas (ankle) and Nelson (knee) will both miss the division game in San Francisco, so Seattle plays with two backups on the offensive line. Coach Mike Macdonald said the team hopes Nelson is back next week.

moves.head: Justin Herbert is in the concussion protocol and expected to miss Week 12; Chargers sign QB Jake Browning to the active roster
moves.plain: Herbert has not practiced since the Week 11 loss and is expected to sit. Undrafted rookie D.J. Uiagalelei is in line to start, with Browning, the former Bengals backup, moved up from the practice squad behind him. The Chargers are 1-9.

moves.head: Steelers activate WR Michael Pittman Jr. off IR; Ben Skowronek goes to IR
moves.plain: Pittman is back from his foot injury in time for Friday's game against Denver. Skowronek (calf) will miss at least four games, and undrafted rookie Max Hurleman, who caught six passes for 61 yards on Sunday, moves up from the practice squad to the active roster.

moves.head: Broncos activate RB Tyler Badie off IR and put DT Sai'vion Jones on IR
moves.plain: Badie is back on the active roster for Friday's game in Pittsburgh, though NFL.com lists him as questionable with a thumb injury. Denver also signed RB Cody Schrader from its practice squad. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Jets activate DL David Onyemata and NT T'Vondre Sweat from IR
moves.plain: Both are back on the active roster, which gives the Jets their run-stuffers back in the middle of the defense.

moves.head: Panthers activate RB Jonathon Brooks from IR
moves.plain: Brooks is back on the active roster and adds depth to Carolina's backfield.

moves.head: Colts activate CB Cam Taylor-Britt from IR
moves.plain: Taylor-Britt is back on the active roster, a help for the Colts secondary.

moves.head: Colts rookie DE Caden Curry is out for the season with a torn wrist ligament
moves.plain: Curry went on injured reserve this week, and ESPN's Stephen Holder reports the torn ligament ends his rookie season. The sixth-round pick had played in all 11 games, with 26 tackles and a sack.

moves.head: Rams RB Kyren Williams has been playing through turf toe
moves.plain: Netflix's Tom Pelissero reports Williams has had turf toe for about a month and it bothers him when he speeds up. He is still playing, and Blake Corum has taken on more of the work.

moves.head: Seahawks restructure the deals of Sam Darnold, Julian Love and Ernest Jones to free cap space
moves.plain: Seattle turned salary into bonus money for three starters, which spreads the cost over later years and frees room under the cap now. The figures in the report come from a cap site we don't use, so no amounts are shown here.

moves.head: Jaguars restructure the deals of Foyesade Oluokun and Walker Little to free cap space
moves.plain: Jacksonville turned salary into bonus money for its linebacker and left tackle, which pushes some of the cost into later years. The figures in the report come from a cap site we don't use, so no amounts are shown here.

moves.head: Aaron Rodgers clears waivers and is a free agent
moves.plain: No team claimed Rodgers or the $8.56 million left on his contract, CBS Sports reports, citing Tom Pelissero. He can now sign with any team, and Pittsburgh goes on with Mason Rudolph at quarterback.

moves.head: Steelers waive QB Aaron Rodgers a day after benching him
moves.plain: Pittsburgh let Rodgers go after his McAfee Show comments about head coach Mike McCarthy, and Mason Rudolph starts Friday against Denver. Any team can claim him until 4 p.m. ET on Nov. 26. Pro Football Rumors says he is owed $8.6 million in guaranteed base salary for the rest of the season on the one-year, $22.5 million deal he signed in May.

moves.head: Brandon Aiyuk agrees to join the Commanders practice squad
moves.plain: Aiyuk, cut by the 49ers on Monday, is heading to Washington's practice squad, where he reunites with quarterback Jayden Daniels. No contract figures were reported. Washington can call practice squad players up for game days.

moves.head: Rams beat the Packers 26-13; Kamren Kinchens ejected for a hit on Christian Watson
moves.plain: Los Angeles won Wednesday night's game 26-13. Rams safety Kamren Kinchens was thrown out for an illegal hit on Packers receiver Christian Watson, who left the game with a concussion.

moves.head: Cardinals claim QB Kedon Slovis off waivers from the Ravens
moves.plain: Arizona picked up Slovis a day after Baltimore waived him, A waiver claim keeps his existing contract; no new terms were reported.

moves.head: Chargers claim DB Avery Smith off waivers from the Seahawks
moves.plain: Los Angeles picked up Smith a day after Seattle waived him. A waiver claim keeps his existing contract; no new terms were reported.

moves.head: 49ers activate CB Nate Hobbs off IR and bring WR Brandin Cooks back on the practice squad
moves.plain: Hobbs is back on the active roster and can help the 49ers secondary this week. Cooks, released last week, returns on the practice squad, so San Francisco can call him up on game days.

moves.head: Brock Purdy is uncertain for Week 12 against Seattle with a low ankle sprain
moves.plain: The 49ers are not sure their starting quarterback can play against the Seahawks. If Purdy sits, Mac Jones starts.

moves.head: Seahawks expect Sam Darnold back for Week 12 against the 49ers
moves.plain: Seattle expects its starting quarterback to return for the division game against San Francisco. Getting Darnold back is a big lift for the offense.

moves.head: Rams activate DL Kobie Turner and OL Justin Dedich from IR
moves.plain: Both are back on the active roster, a boost for the Rams on both lines.

moves.head: Kenneth Walker III is out for Thanksgiving against the Bills
moves.plain: The Chiefs running back has a groin injury and will miss his third straight game. Kansas City has to lean on its other backs again on Thursday.

moves.head: Cowboys activate S Jalen Thompson off IR
moves.plain: Thompson is back on the active roster, giving Dallas another experienced safety for the stretch run.

moves.head: Titans waive EDGE Tanoh Kpassagnon and sign CB Corey Thornton
moves.plain: Tennessee let Kpassagnon go with an injury settlement and used the spot on Thornton, signed off the Panthers' practice squad. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Dolphins sign P Jack Browning to the 53-man roster
moves.plain: Miami moved Browning up from the practice squad because punter Bradley Pinion is hurt. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Colts sign OT Wanya Morris off the Cowboys practice squad
moves.plain: Indianapolis added Morris to its active roster for offensive line depth. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Eagles sign DT Gabe Hall to the active roster
moves.plain: Philadelphia moved Hall up from its practice squad for defensive line depth. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Six players start their return from IR, including Romeo Doubs and T'Vondre Sweat
moves.plain: Practice windows opened for Patriots WR Romeo Doubs, Jets NT T'Vondre Sweat, Buccaneers WR Jalen McMillan and LB Christian Rozeboom, Jaguars G Patrick Mekari and Raiders EDGE Patrick Johnson. They can practice now and come back to the active roster later.

moves.head: Jets waive DT Payton Page and release DL Isaiahh Loudermilk from the practice squad
moves.plain: New York trimmed two defensive linemen. Page goes on waivers, where any team can claim him, and Loudermilk is a free agent.

moves.head: Chiefs put FB Ben VanSumeren on IR and promote T Fred Johnson
moves.plain: VanSumeren goes on injured reserve, and Kansas City used his roster spot on Johnson, moved up from the practice squad for offensive line depth.

moves.head: Seahawks sign T Chase Lundt off the Bills practice squad and waive CB Avery Smith
moves.plain: Seattle added Lundt for offensive line depth and cut Smith to make room. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Steelers bench Aaron Rodgers; Mason Rudolph starts Friday against the Broncos
moves.plain: Pittsburgh is turning to Rudolph for Friday's home game against Denver, NFL Network's Cameron Wolfe reported, and NFL.com says Rodgers will be inactive. Rodgers was not on the injury report, so this is a straight benching. He re-signed this year on a one-year, $22.5 million deal.

moves.head: Broncos suspend RB J.K. Dobbins for Week 12
moves.plain: Sean Payton announced a one-game ban for conduct detrimental to the team, so Dobbins misses Friday's game at Pittsburgh and can return in Week 13. He is in the first year of a two-year, $16 million deal with $8 million guaranteed.

moves.head: Brandon Aiyuk clears waivers and visits the Commanders
moves.plain: No team claimed Aiyuk after the 49ers let him go on Monday, so he is a free agent and can pick his next team, ESPN's Adam Schefter reported. Washington has him in for a visit on Wednesday. Whoever signs him pays only his new deal, not the rest of his old $120 million contract.

moves.head: Ravens waive returner LaJohntay Wester and QB Kedon Slovis
moves.plain: Baltimore cut Wester after he muffed two punts in Sunday's loss to the Panthers. Slovis was waived too, and NFL Network's Mike Garafolo says the Ravens hope to bring him back on the practice squad if he clears waivers. The Ravens are 4-7.

moves.head: Bears claim CB Isaac Yiadom off waivers from the Commanders
moves.plain: Chicago picked up Yiadom a day after Washington waived him, adding depth with Kyler Gordon missing practice. A waiver claim keeps his existing contract; no new terms were reported.

moves.head: Lions DT Skyler Gill-Howard is out for the season with a knee injury
moves.plain: Dan Campbell said the rookie defensive tackle needs knee surgery and will miss the rest of 2026. It is another hit to a Detroit defensive line already without Aidan Hutchinson.

moves.head: Giants put CB Greg Newsome II on injured reserve after ankle surgery
moves.plain: Newsome is expected to miss four to six weeks, so he sits out at least the next four games. He signed a new deal with the Giants earlier this month.

moves.head: Panthers G Brady Christensen reverts to season-ending injured reserve
moves.plain: Carolina did not activate Christensen before his three-week return window closed, so he cannot play again this season. He was on a one-year, $2.77 million deal.

moves.head: Colts sign QB Shane Buechele off the Bills' practice squad; Caden Curry to IR
moves.plain: With Daniel Jones gone, Indianapolis added Buechele behind Anthony Richardson and Riley Leonard; no contract terms were reported. The Colts also promoted DE Carl Lawson from the practice squad and put DE Caden Curry on injured reserve.

moves.head: Lions owner emerita Martha Firestone Ford dies at 101
moves.plain: Ford owned the Lions from 2014, after her husband William Clay Ford died, until handing control to their daughter Sheila Ford Hamp in 2020. The team is 8-2 this season.

moves.head: Commanders activate RB Jacory Croskey-Merritt from IR
moves.plain: The running back is back on the active roster. Washington waived cornerback Isaac Yiadom to make room.

moves.head: Bengals activate LB Swayze Bozeman and G Brian Parker II from IR
moves.plain: Both are back on Cincinnati's active roster, adding depth at linebacker and on the offensive line.

moves.head: 49ers RT Colton McKivitz is out for the season with a fractured, dislocated ankle
moves.plain: The injury from Sunday's game in Mexico City ends McKivitz's season. Vederian Lowe takes over at right tackle for the 9-1 49ers.

moves.head: Cardinals fire defensive coordinator Nick Rallis; Teryl Austin takes over for the rest of the season
moves.plain: Arizona let Rallis go after another blowout loss on Sunday, the second game in a row the defense gave up 34 points, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport first reported. He had run the defense since 2023 and was kept on by new head coach Mike LaFleur. Senior defensive assistant Teryl Austin, a former coordinator with the Lions, Bengals and Steelers, is the interim coordinator. The Cardinals are 3-8.

moves.head: 49ers sign general manager John Lynch to an extension
moves.plain: Lynch finalized a new deal shortly before Sunday's game, Fox Sports' Jay Glazer reports; the length and money were not given. He has run the front office alongside head coach Kyle Shanahan since 2017, and both have now been extended three times. San Francisco is 9-1 and leads the NFC.

moves.head: Rams TE Terrance Ferguson is out for the season and needs ankle surgery
moves.plain: Ferguson will not be brought back from injured reserve, ESPN's Sarah Barshop reports, and NFL Network's Ian Rapoport says he needs surgery. He sprained his ankle in Week 3, and Sean McVay said the injury is just not healing the way the team wanted. Tyler Higbee, Colby Parkinson and Davis Allen keep sharing the tight end snaps.

moves.head: Packers clear Micah Parsons to make his debut Wednesday against the Rams
moves.plain: Parsons has been cleared to come off the reserve/PUP list in time for the Nov. 25 game against the Rams, NFL.com's Ian Rapoport reports. He tore his ACL and meniscus in Week 15 last season. Getting their star pass rusher back is a big lift for Green Bay's defense, and his return does not use one of the team's eight injury activations.

moves.head: Seahawks promote CB Trevon Diggs and OT Bobby Hart to the active roster; RB George Holani goes on IR
moves.plain: Seattle signed Diggs and Hart from its practice squad to the 53-man roster, and put Holani on injured reserve. The terms of the new deals were not reported. The move gives Seattle two more veterans on the game-day roster.

moves.head: Dolphins waive LB Shaka Heyward and EDGE Max Llewellyn
moves.plain: Miami put both players on waivers on Monday, freeing two roster spots. Any team can claim them before they become free agents.

moves.head: Falcons waive LB Christian Harris and promote S Jammie Robinson
moves.plain: Atlanta cut Harris on Monday, NFL.com's daily roundup and the league's transaction wire show, and signed safety Jammie Robinson from the practice squad to the active roster. Harris joined the Falcons in March on a one-year deal. He goes on waivers first, so another team can claim him.

moves.head: Commanders waive CB Isaac Yiadom
moves.plain: Washington cut Yiadom on Monday, NFL.com's daily roundup and the league's transaction wire show. The Commanders also brought running back Jacory Croskey-Merritt back from injured reserve the same day.

moves.head: Patriots open G Alijah Vera-Tucker's return window; Tommy DeVito will start at QB
moves.plain: New England designated Vera-Tucker to return from injured reserve, KPRC2's Aaron Wilson reports; he started the first six games before a hamstring injury in late October. With Drake Maye out with a fractured fibula, Mike Vrabel said Tommy DeVito is in line to start and a quarterback signing is not expected right away. The Patriots are 5-5.

moves.head: 49ers waive WR Brandon Aiyuk
moves.plain: San Francisco let Aiyuk go on Monday, the day his roster exemption ran out, ESPN's Adam Schefter first reported; he goes on waivers first, and a free-agent deal is the next step if no team claims him. He has not played since tearing his ACL seven games into 2024, the season he signed a four-year, $120MM extension. Washington is seen as his preferred landing spot, and the money the 49ers say he owes them from voided guarantees may be settled later.

moves.head: Week 11: 49ers beat Vikings 35-10 in Mexico City, Bills and Broncos keep rolling
moves.plain: San Francisco won 35-10 in Mexico City to go 9-1, and Minnesota drops to 7-3. Buffalo beat Miami 26-9 to reach 9-1, and Denver, Chicago, Detroit and Kansas City all won to sit at 8-2. The Jets beat the Chargers 27-24, and Justin Herbert was put in the concussion protocol after the game; the Chargers are 1-9. Philadelphia edged Pittsburgh 19-16, but Saquon Barkley left in the fourth quarter with an apparent shoulder issue.

moves.head: 49ers RT Colton McKivitz is carted off with a lower leg injury in Mexico City
moves.plain: McKivitz needed an aircast and a cart late in the win over the Vikings, the Bay Area News Group's Cam Inman reports; no diagnosis has been announced and more tests will show how bad it is. He had played all but 50 of the offense's snaps since the start of 2023. Vederian Lowe took over at right tackle, and the 49ers are thin behind him with Austen Pleasants on injured reserve.

moves.head: Mahomes has been playing with a small elbow ligament sprain; Andrews and Queen played with broken hands
moves.plain: ESPN's Adam Schefter reports Mahomes has a muscle strain and a very small UCL sprain from a Week 9 strip-sack against the Jets; two team doctors cleared him, and he has thrown for 642 yards and eight touchdowns with no interceptions in the two games since. Ravens TE Mark Andrews played with a broken hand from Week 3 on and is now fully healed, ESPN's Lisa Salters reports. Steelers LB Patrick Queen has a broken hand, The Athletic confirmed, but he still played every snap in Sunday's loss to the Eagles.

moves.head: Former Broncos LB and ESPN broadcaster Tom Jackson dies at 75
moves.plain: Jackson, a Broncos Ring of Fame linebacker, died Friday, his family told ESPN. He was a three-time Pro Bowler and a First Team All-Pro on Denver's 1977 Super Bowl team, and his 20 interceptions tie Randy Gradishar for the most by a Broncos linebacker. He then spent nearly 30 years at ESPN alongside Chris Berman.

moves.head: 49ers expected to release WR Brandon Aiyuk when his roster exemption ends Monday
moves.plain: San Francisco must cut Aiyuk or put him back on the active roster and pay him when the exemption runs out on Monday, and a release is expected; it has not happened yet. He would have to clear waivers first, and the Commanders are seen as the leading landing spot, with the Seahawks, Rams and Vikings also mentioned. The team and his camp are still discussing $13MM in bonus money the 49ers believe he gave up, which agent Drew Rosenhaus wants to settle separately.

moves.head: Rams WR Davante Adams will not return in Week 12
moves.plain: Adams is still on injured reserve after hamstring surgery. NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports he will miss the Thanksgiving Eve game, a Week 13 return is a longshot, and he may not be back until Week 14 against the 49ers. With Puka Nacua out for the season, the 6-4 Rams are short at receiver for the playoff push.

moves.head: Chargers LB Daiyan Henley ruled out for Week 11 with a knee injury
moves.plain: Henley missed a full week of practice before being ruled out. He is the linebacker whose deadline trade to Denver fell apart after a failed physical. He is a pending free agent, and the Chargers are open to re-signing him.

moves.head: Colts shut down WR Alec Pierce for the rest of 2026 with a heel injury
moves.plain: Pierce had ankle and heel surgery in the spring and hurt the heel again in Week 2, his last game; he played only two games and caught five passes for 72 yards. NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports he is expected to be fully healthy in 2027. The 3-8 Colts lose a receiver they gave a four-year, $114M extension in March, and the group is now led by Laquon Treadwell.

moves.head: Panthers put S Isaiah Simmons on injured reserve and bring back CB Mike Jackson
moves.plain: Simmons went on injured reserve with a knee injury, NFL.com's Saturday roundup shows, so he must miss at least four games. Cornerback Mike Jackson came back from injured reserve after a groin injury, which helps the secondary right away.

moves.head: Bengals put LB Oren Burks on injured reserve
moves.plain: Burks went on injured reserve with a groin injury, Pro Football Rumors' daily transactions list shows. Cincinnati is down a veteran linebacker for at least the next few weeks.

moves.head: Rams open DE Kobie Turner's window to return from injured reserve
moves.plain: Turner was designated to return and can practice for up to 21 days before the Rams must activate him, NFL.com's Saturday roundup shows. Getting him back would boost the Rams' defensive line for the stretch run.

moves.head: Lions put C Cade Mays back on injured reserve with an ankle injury
moves.plain: Mays was activated a month ago but played only two games before the ankle injury, and he is expected to miss at least four more games. Practice squad CB Nick Whiteside takes his spot on the 53-man roster. Juice Scruggs, who has started the last three games, stays at center.

moves.head: 49ers waive WR Brandin Cooks
moves.plain: San Francisco waived Cooks on Saturday and activated DT CJ West from injured reserve. The move comes as Mike Evans, out the last three games with Achilles tendonitis, is on track to return against the Vikings on Sunday, NFL Network's Ian Rapoport reports.

moves.head: Cowboys put CB DaRon Bland on injured reserve with a high ankle sprain
moves.plain: Bland was hurt in the first quarter of the Week 10 loss to the 49ers and will miss at least four games, NFL Network's Mike Garafolo reports. It is his third straight season cut short by injury. Joey Porter Jr., acquired from Pittsburgh this season, becomes Dallas's top cornerback.

moves.head: Eagles put LB Zack Baun and WR Dontayvion Wicks on injured reserve
moves.plain: Baun hurt his back in the Nov. 8 loss to the Giants and Wicks has an ankle injury that has cost him the last three games. Both will miss at least four games and cannot return before Week 15. Jihaad Campbell and Jeremiah Trotter Jr. are expected to start at linebacker for the 2-7 Eagles, and DeVonta Smith is set to return from a hamstring injury.

moves.head: Cardinals rule out QB Carson Beck (back) and turn to 40-year-old Josh Johnson at Kansas City
moves.plain: Beck, a rookie third-round pick, has back spasms and was ruled out for Sunday, ESPN's Josh Weinfuss reports. Johnson, signed off the Bengals' practice squad last week, makes his 12th career start. He is Arizona's fourth starter in recent weeks, after Jacoby Brissett, Gardner Minshew and Beck.

moves.head: Dolphins have three defensive tackles on injured reserve and lean on Kenneth Grant
moves.plain: Sieler (biceps) and Biggers (knee) had season-ending surgery, and Phillips is recovering from a biceps injury; the three had played 1,050 defensive snaps between them this year. Kenneth Grant, the 2025 first-round pick, is expected to play more, with Keith Cooper Jr. and Jordan Jefferson also in the mix. With the trade deadline passed, Miami can only add help through free agency or waivers.

moves.head: Titans put RB Tyjae Spears on injured reserve with a knee injury
moves.plain: Tennessee moved Spears to injured reserve on Saturday, so he will miss at least the next four games. The Titans called up RB Michael Carter from the practice squad for Sunday's game against Dallas.

moves.head: Saints sign K Charlie Smyth to the active roster on a two-year deal
moves.plain: New Orleans promoted Smyth from the practice squad on a deal that runs through 2027 and pays the league minimum for the rest of 2026; the report did not give a total or any guarantees. He made 4 of 5 field goals, with a long of 55, in his last two games as a call-up.

moves.head: Titans DL Jaylen Harrell is in the hospital after a serious car crash in Tampa
moves.plain: The Titans said Harrell was hurt in a serious crash on Friday and taken to a hospital in his hometown of Tampa, and asked for privacy for his family. Police allege that Harrell, a passenger in a rideshare car, assaulted the driver while it was moving, causing the crash, WTSP reports; the report did not mention any charges. Harrell was already out for the season after tearing his ACL in August.

moves.head: Colts waive QB Daniel Jones and turn to Anthony Richardson
moves.plain: Coach Shane Steichen announced the move Friday and said Jones did not ask to be released; Jones leads the NFL with 13 interceptions this season. He is on waivers until Monday afternoon, and a team that claims him would owe the rest of his 2026 base salary (about $2.14M) and a $10.51M injury guarantee for 2027 from the two-year, $88M deal he signed in March, so a claim is unlikely. Anthony Richardson is expected to start, and the report did not give the Colts' dead money.

moves.head: Colts start a preliminary GM candidate list; Shane Steichen not expected to be fired midseason
moves.plain: Indianapolis parted ways with GM Chris Ballard about a month ago after a five-game midseason slide, and has begun a preliminary list of candidates, Bleacher Report's James Palmer reports. Palmer expects the Colts to keep evaluating Steichen through the end of the season rather than fire him now; owner Carlie Irsay-Gordon had a big say in hiring him. Steichen is 28-34 as the Colts' coach.

moves.head: Chargers OLB Bud Dupree asks for his release for the second time
moves.plain: Dupree asked to be let go before the season and has asked again, ESPN's Jeremy Fowler reports; the Chargers have not granted it. He has no sacks through 10 weeks, has mostly played special teams since the bye and was a healthy scratch in Week 10.

moves.head: Patriots QB Drake Maye has a fractured fibula and is likely out for the rest of the regular season
moves.plain: Maye's right leg injury is a broken fibula, ESPN's Mike Reiss and Adam Schefter report; he does not need surgery, so he could come back if New England is still in the playoff race. Tommy DeVito starts after the bye, ending Maye's run of 43 straight starts. WR A.J. Brown is also expected to miss multiple weeks with a hamstring injury, with the 5-5 Patriots one game out of the AFC's last wild-card spot.

moves.head: Rams WR Puka Nacua had MCL surgery and is likely done for 2026
moves.plain: Coach Sean McVay said Friday that Nacua had knee surgery on Tuesday and will be out multiple months, ESPN's Sarah Barshop reports, which all but ends his season. An NFL spokesperson told The Athletic the league did not know about the surgery when it suspended him for three games a day earlier. Nacua is a pending free agent, and the 6-4 Rams are waiting on Davante Adams to return.

moves.head: Commanders LT Laremy Tunsil not expected to play in the 2026 regular season
moves.plain: Tunsil tore his triceps in August and has been on injured reserve since just after final cuts. The Washington Post's Tashan Reed reports he is not expected back for the rest of the regular season, though a playoff return is possible. Brandon Coleman keeps playing left tackle for the 3-5-1 Commanders.

moves.head: Vikings rule out QB Kyler Murray and WR Jordan Addison against the 49ers
moves.plain: Murray (hamstring) and Addison (thumb) will both miss Sunday's game against San Francisco in Mexico City. TE T.J. Hockenson is off the injury report after a wrist problem. The report did not say who will start at quarterback.

moves.head: Broncos extend CB Riley Moss for four years and $67M
moves.plain: Denver added four years to Moss's rookie deal, which was due to run out after this season, at $16.75M a year. He is now signed through 2030. Moss, a 2023 third-round pick, led the NFL with 19 pass breakups last season and is still a starter this year. Guarantees and the signing bonus were not reported.

moves.head: Saints agree to release S Justin Reid at his request
moves.plain: Reid asked to be let go earlier this week, NewOrleans.Football reports, and he will not play Sunday against the Bears. The move was not yet on the league's transaction report Thursday, and because the trade deadline has passed he goes on waivers first. Jordan Howden, who has taken some of Reid's snaps in recent weeks, is set to start.

moves.head: NFL suspends Rams WR Puka Nacua for three games
moves.plain: The suspension under the personal conduct policy came out of a settlement between the league and the players' union, ESPN reports. It follows a lawsuit filed in March that accused Nacua of biting a woman. He is already on injured reserve with a knee injury, so he serves it while he is out, is eligible to return in Week 14 and gives up about $960K in game checks.

moves.head: Ravens send CB Marlon Humphrey home and bench him for Sunday at Carolina
moves.plain: Baltimore will deactivate Humphrey for the Week 11 game after remarks about the city on his podcast drew wide criticism; he has apologized. Coach Jesse Minter said the benching is for one game only. Chidobe Awuzie and T.J. Tampa will play more at corner as the 4-6 Ravens try to end a five-game losing streak.

moves.head: Titans WR Calvin Ridley charged with misdemeanor assault
moves.plain: The charge comes from a Nov 7 incident at Nashville International Airport, where he is accused of grabbing his keys from a valet worker and cutting the man's hand. He is due in court Dec 7. The Titans declined to comment while the police investigation goes on, and Ridley could also face league discipline under the personal conduct policy.

moves.head: Eagles coach Nick Sirianni backs offensive coordinator Sean Mannion
moves.plain: Sirianni weighed staff changes over the bye, but Mannion said Thursday that the two are in lockstep, The Athletic reports. Philadelphia is 2-7 and last in the league in total offense, with Jalen Hurts out for the season and several other starters missing games.

moves.head: Thursday night: Texans beat Colts 26-3
moves.plain: Houston scored the last 26 points after a Colts field goal on the opening drive. C.J. Stroud threw three touchdown passes, David Montgomery ran for 107 yards and Will Anderson Jr. sacked Daniel Jones for a safety. The Texans are 4-6 and the Colts fall to 3-8.

moves.head: Cowboys hand defensive play-calling to senior assistant Mike Pettine
moves.plain: Christian Parker keeps the defensive coordinator title, but Mike Pettine, brought out of retirement in October, will now call the defensive plays, ESPN reports. The change comes a day after Jerry Jones said the team was discussing Parker's future. Dallas is 4-6 and its defense ranks 30th in points allowed and last in yards allowed after giving up 46 points to the 49ers in Week 10.

moves.head: Seahawks expect QB Sam Darnold back after their Week 11 bye
moves.plain: Darnold has missed the last two games with quad and rib injuries, but Seattle never put him on injured reserve. Coach Mike Macdonald expects him to start when the team returns from the bye, on the road against the 49ers. Drew Lock started while he was out.

moves.head: Chiefs put TE Jared Wiley on injured reserve and activate DT Omarr Norman-Lott
moves.plain: Wiley goes on injured reserve, so he misses at least four games. The transaction list does not say what the injury is. Kansas City also brought defensive tackle Omarr Norman-Lott back from the physically unable to perform list.

moves.head: Steelers open the return window for WRs Michael Pittman Jr. and Roman Wilson and OL Gennings Dunker
moves.plain: All three can now practice again after time on injured reserve: Pittman hurt his foot three games into the season, Wilson went down in Week 5 and rookie Dunker sprained his MCL in late September. Pittsburgh has 21 days to add each of them back to the active roster. The two receivers may need some practice time before they play.

moves.head: Jaguars C Robert Hainsey is week to week with a knee sprain
moves.plain: Coach Liam Coen said Hainsey will miss Sunday's game against the Giants. Jacksonville needs a fill-in at center while he is out.

moves.head: Texans get RB David Montgomery back but rule out Danielle Hunter and Marvin Harrison Jr. for Thursday vs the Colts
moves.plain: Hunter and Harrison (both hamstrings), running back Woody Marks (concussion) and tight end Brevin Jordan will miss Thursday's game. Montgomery is set to play for the first time since Week 5 after a groin injury and should take back the starting job while Marks sits. The Colts are without tackle Bernhard Raimann (concussion), lineman Jalen Travis (knee) and cornerback Charvarius Ward (knee).

moves.head: Vikings put OLB Bo Richter on injured reserve; WR Jordan Addison avoids it
moves.plain: Richter goes on injured reserve with a foot injury, so he misses at least four games. Coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison's thumb surgery on Monday went well and he will not go on injured reserve.

moves.head: Eagles QB Joe Milton III will start Sunday against the Steelers
moves.plain: Coach Nick Sirianni named Milton the starter. He made his first career start in Week 9 against the Giants, going 18 of 34 for 169 yards and running for 64 more. The report does not say why he is starting.

moves.head: Jets open the return window for DT David Onyemata
moves.plain: Onyemata has been on injured reserve since core muscle surgery in late September, and he can now practice again. New York has 21 days to put him back on the active roster; it is not clear if he plays Sunday against the Chargers. The 2-8 Jets have lost seven of eight games since he got hurt.

moves.head: Steelers G Mason McCormick dislocates his ankle
moves.plain: McCormick dislocated his ankle in Sunday's loss to Cincinnati. There is no fracture and he does not need surgery, and he could be back for the playoffs. Pittsburgh needs a new starter at guard.

moves.head: Texans put LB Azeez Al-Shaair on injured reserve; he needs groin surgery
moves.plain: Al-Shaair will miss at least four games and his return is unclear. Henry To'oTo'o takes over the defensive play calls. Al-Shaair signed a three-year, $54M extension in April.

moves.head: Titans put WR Wan'Dale Robinson on injured reserve
moves.plain: Robinson, signed to a four-year, $70M deal in March, is out at least four games with an ankle injury. Xavier Restrepo was promoted from the practice squad to take his spot.

moves.head: Dolphins DT Jordan Phillips is out for the season with a torn biceps
moves.plain: Phillips went on injured reserve, another blow to a Miami line that already lost Zeek Biggers. The Dolphins also signed kicker Daniel Carlson to the practice squad after waiving Zane Gonzalez.

moves.head: Cardinals QB Gardner Minshew's season is over after elbow surgery
moves.plain: Minshew tore the UCL in his throwing elbow and will have surgery; he is expected to be ready for 2027. Rookie Carson Beck stays the starter.

moves.head: Colts put LB Jaylon Carlies on injured reserve with a neck injury
moves.plain: Carlies can return in Week 16 at the earliest. WR Quez Watkins was signed from the practice squad to fill the roster spot.

moves.head: Jerry Jones says the Cowboys are discussing defensive coordinator Christian Parker's future
moves.plain: Dallas is 4-6 and last in the league in yards allowed. Jones would not say more, and no change has been made yet. Mike Pettine, who joined the staff last month, could take over the calls.

moves.head: Lions expect S Kerby Joseph to make his season debut against Tampa Bay
moves.plain: Joseph has been out all season with a knee condition. Dan Campbell says he should play in Week 11, a lift for a defense that just lost Aidan Hutchinson.

moves.head: NFL flexes Raiders at Browns into Sunday night in Week 12
moves.plain: Las Vegas at Cleveland moves to Sunday Night Football on Nov 29. New England at the Chargers moves to the late afternoon window, and Tennessee at Jacksonville moves to 1 p.m.

moves.head: Dolphins waive K Zane Gonzalez after a two-point loss
moves.plain: Gonzalez missed two of three field goals and an extra point in the 24-22 loss to the Colts. Miami is looking for its third kicker of the season.

moves.head: Monday night: Chargers beat Ravens 23-20 for their first win
moves.plain: The Chargers won for the first time this season and are 1-8. Baltimore has lost five straight and is 4-6. Jacoby Brissett threw for 340 yards in his Ravens debut, but Zay Flowers lost a fumble with about two minutes left.

moves.head: Lions DE Aidan Hutchinson tears his ACL and is out for the season
moves.plain: Follow-up tests confirmed the tear, which happened while he celebrated a sack in Munich. He is expected back for the start of 2027. LB Jack Campbell also has a neck injury the team is still assessing.

moves.head: Patriots fear QB Drake Maye fractured his ankle
moves.plain: Maye was hurt on the first drive of the 35-10 loss to Detroit in Munich and could miss the rest of the season. More tests are coming. New England has its bye next and about $5.5M in cap space if it looks for a quarterback.

moves.head: Vikings WR Jordan Addison needs thumb surgery
moves.plain: Addison hurt the thumb in practice and is expected to miss a few weeks; a short injured reserve stint is possible. His fifth-year option was exercised, so his 2027 pay is already guaranteed.

moves.head: Rams lose both centers: Coleman Shelton out 4-6 weeks, Dylan McMahon to IR
moves.plain: Starter Shelton has a hamstring strain. Backup McMahon partly tore a patellar tendon and goes on injured reserve, so the Rams need a third option in the middle of the line.

moves.head: Cardinals lose DE Jordan Burch for the season
moves.plain: Burch hurt his MCL in the 34-6 loss to the Rams. S Andrew Wingard has a wrist and hand injury and will miss an extended stretch.

moves.head: Cowboys G Tyler Booker has a high ankle sprain; CB DaRon Bland also hurt
moves.plain: Both were hurt in the 46-40 loss to the 49ers. Booker is expected to miss a few weeks, with T.J. Bass filling in. Bland has no timeline yet.

moves.head: Dolphins DL Zeek Biggers needs season-ending knee surgery
moves.plain: Biggers tore the lateral meniscus in his knee. It adds to a long injury list for a 1-8 team that already lost Zach Sieler for the year.

moves.head: Jets coach Aaron Glenn hands defensive play-calling to Brian Duker
moves.plain: Glenn gave the calls to his defensive coordinator in the 31-12 loss to Buffalo. Reports say his job is in question. Geno Smith's ankle injury is not serious and he stays the starter.

moves.head: Packers say Micah Parsons is not certain to return in Week 12
moves.plain: Parsons is coming back from ACL and meniscus surgery and must be activated by Nov 25 or he cannot play this season. Guard Kevin Zeitler (triceps) avoided injured reserve and could start in Week 12.

moves.head: Cardinals extend TE Elijah Higgins for three years, up to $26.8M
moves.plain: Arizona added three years to Higgins' rookie deal, which ran out after this season. The extension can pay up to $26.8M and keeps him signed through 2029. Guarantees were not reported.

moves.head: Falcons give CB C.J. Henderson a two-year extension worth up to $20M
moves.plain: Atlanta announced a two-year extension for Henderson, who was headed for free agency after this season. The deal is worth up to $20M with almost $11M guaranteed. It keeps him signed through 2028 (calculated: the report gives no end year).

moves.head: Falcons extend edge rusher Cameron Thomas for three years, up to $33M
moves.plain: Thomas signed a one-year deal worth just over $3M in March and earned a raise. The three-year extension has a maximum value of $33M and runs through 2029. Guarantees were not reported.

moves.head: Eagles waive backup T Fred Johnson
moves.plain: Johnson re-signed in March on a one-year deal and had played 24 snaps. He goes on waivers; if no team claims him, Philadelphia carries nearly $2M in dead money.

moves.head: Eagles waive WR Marquise Brown
moves.plain: Both sides agreed a split would help. He signed a one-year deal with $5M guaranteed in March, so that money is already owed. As a vested veteran he goes through waivers first.

moves.head: Rams, Chiefs and Broncos restructure deals to free cap space
moves.plain: The Rams restructured RB Kyren Williams and S Kamren Curl to gain about $3M in cap space. The Chiefs restructured LB Nick Bolton to free $3.4M, and the Broncos cut S Talanoa Hufanga's 2026 cap charge by $3.9M. A restructure moves pay into later years; it does not add new money. The report does not give new contract totals, and the date is inferred from the deadline-week report.

moves.head: Vikings reacquire QB Kirk Cousins from the Raiders for a 2027 third-round pick
moves.plain: Cousins goes back to Minnesota, where he played from 2018 to 2023. The Raiders get a third-round pick and no longer owe him a fully guaranteed $10M roster bonus due in March 2027. Las Vegas pays him only about $500K of his 2026 salary; the Vikings cover the rest. Las Vegas named rookie Fernando Mendoza its starter after the trade.

moves.head: Chiefs acquire WR Josh Downs and a 2027 seventh-round pick from the Colts for 2027 fourth- and fifth-round picks
moves.plain: Kansas City adds a slot receiver for the second half of the season. Downs is in the last year of his rookie deal, so he can be a free agent after the season. Indianapolis, at 2-7, picks up two mid-round picks.

moves.head: Bills acquire S Amani Hooker and a 2027 fifth-round pick from the Titans for a 2027 second-round pick
moves.plain: Buffalo adds a starting safety under contract through 2028. Tennessee keeps none of the roughly $4.5M left on his 2026 pay. The Bills restructured LT Dion Dawkins' deal to make the cap room; the figures were not reported.

moves.head: 49ers acquire WR Keenan Allen from the Colts for a 2027 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: San Francisco adds a veteran receiver with Mike Evans and Deebo Samuel hurt. Allen signed a one-year deal with Indianapolis in August, so he is a free agent again after the season.

moves.head: Ravens get C Ryan Neuzil from the Falcons for G Andrew Vorhees and a 2028 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Baltimore has put three centers on injured reserve this season, and Neuzil has started all 38 of his career games at center. Atlanta gets a backup guard and a late pick. Neuzil is a pending free agent.

moves.head: Ravens, Patriots and Panthers restructure Nnamdi Madubuike, Hunter Henry and Taylor Moton for cap room
moves.plain: Baltimore turned most of Madubuike's 2026 salary into a bonus and added two void years, clearing $8.66M. New England's base-to-bonus conversion for Henry cleared $3.3M. Carolina converted $5.3M of Moton's salary, saving $3.5M now and pushing more of his cap charge into later years.

moves.head: Bills restructure LT Dion Dawkins' contract to fit the Amani Hooker trade
moves.plain: GM Brandon Beane said Buffalo reworked Dawkins' deal to make cap room for Hooker. No figures were reported, so his contract numbers here are unchanged.

moves.head: Falcons release K Nick Folk and sign K Jake Moody off the Ravens' practice squad
moves.plain: Folk had made 13 of 18 field goals this season. Moody gets another chance as Atlanta's kicker.

moves.head: Jaguars acquire DT Jordan Davis from the Eagles for a 2027 first-round pick and a 2029 second-round pick
moves.plain: Jacksonville takes on Davis' three-year, $78M extension signed in March, which runs through 2029. Philadelphia, at 2-7, adds a second 2027 first-round pick. It was the Jaguars' third trade of the day.

moves.head: Jaguars acquire DT Davon Godchaux from the Saints for a conditional 2028 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Godchaux steps in at nose tackle after DaVon Hamilton's season-ending quad injury. He is in the last year of his contract. Per ESPN, the pick becomes a 2027 sixth-rounder if Jacksonville acquires one.

moves.head: Lions acquire S Andre Cisco from the Jets for a 2029 sixth-round pick
moves.plain: Detroit adds safety depth while Kerby Joseph works back from a knee injury. Cisco, 26, had barely played on defense since Week 3 and is on a one-year deal. The pick was first reported as a 2028 sixth-rounder; on Nov 14 the teams changed it to a 2029 sixth at Detroit's request, per Pro Football Rumors. The Jets carry $500K in dead money and save $1.75M.

moves.head: Jaguars acquire S Jessie Bates from the Falcons for a 2027 second-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick
moves.plain: Jacksonville gets the All-Pro safety and Atlanta gets two future picks. Atlanta is keeping most of his remaining 2026 salary to make the deal work, per NFL Network. His contract voids shortly after this season, so he is set to be a free agent.

moves.head: Ravens agree to acquire QB Jacoby Brissett from the Cardinals
moves.plain: Baltimore gets the 33-year-old backup quarterback and a 2027 fifth-round pick; Arizona gets a 2027 fourth-round pick and a 2028 seventh-round pick, per NFL.com. Arizona reworked his 2026 deal to make it easier for Baltimore to take on, turning $2.7M of remaining salary into a signing bonus. He is a pending free agent and is expected to start for the Ravens.

moves.head: Giants extend CB Greg Newsome for three years, $46M
moves.plain: Newsome gets $46M over three more years, about $15.3M a year, with $32M guaranteed. He had been on a one-year, $8M deal, so he will not reach free agency in 2027.

moves.head: Colts agree to two-year, $35M extension with DT Adetomiwa Adebawore
moves.plain: The deal is worth $35M with a $13M signing bonus, and $22.5M of it is new money due by the end of 2027. The report gives the average as $17M a year; guaranteed money was not stated.

moves.head: Bills release S C.J. Gardner-Johnson
moves.plain: Cutting him frees $500K in cap space and leaves $2.02M in dead money. He was on a one-year, $3.5M deal with $3.02M guaranteed.

moves.head: Saints release K Daniel Carlson, claim RB Audric Estime from Browns
moves.plain: Releasing Carlson saves $1.26M in cap room; his 2026 deal was $1.49M with none guaranteed. New Orleans also claimed running back Audric Estime off waivers from Cleveland.

moves.head: Bears get DT Jeffery Simmons from the Titans for two first-round picks
moves.plain: Tennessee gets Chicago's 2027 and 2028 first-round picks and a 2027 fourth. Chicago also gets a 2028 fifth. Simmons, 29, is a first-team All-Pro who signed a three-year, $105.8M extension in June. He has 4 sacks and 12 pressures in 7 games for the 1-6 Titans, and the 5-2 Bears had been looking for help rushing the passer.

moves.head: Titans claim DT Jonah Laulu off waivers
moves.plain: The Raiders cut Laulu on Oct 27 and Tennessee won the waiver claim, then waived DT Timmy Horne. Several other teams also put in claims. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Colts trade DT DeForest Buckner back to the 49ers
moves.plain: Indianapolis sends the 32-year-old defensive tackle to San Francisco, where he started his career, for a 2027 fourth-round pick. He had four sacks in seven games for the 2-5 Colts. The 49ers have lost several defensive linemen to injury, and no new contract was reported.

moves.head: Colts agree to trade G Quenton Nelson to the Seahawks
moves.plain: Seattle sends Indianapolis a 2027 third-round pick and a 2028 fifth-round pick for the veteran guard. He is in the last year of his contract, and no new deal was reported.

moves.head: Seahawks cut G Christian Haynes; Dolphins claim him
moves.plain: Seattle released the guard on Oct 27 and Miami picked him up off waivers the next day, cutting DJ Campbell. No contract figures were reported.

moves.head: Browns extend DT Maliek Collins for two years
moves.plain: Cleveland agreed to a two-year, $30 million extension with the defensive tackle, with $23 million guaranteed. It keeps him under contract through 2028.

moves.head: 49ers release DL Ogbonnia Okoronkwo
moves.plain: San Francisco released the defensive lineman on Oct. 23. No other detail was reported.

moves.head: Vikings release RB DeeJay Dallas and T Tristan Leigh
moves.plain: Minnesota cut both players and added OLB Jihad Ward to the practice squad. No contract terms were reported.

moves.head: Steelers release S Rayshawn Jenkins
moves.plain: Pittsburgh cut the 32-year-old safety, who had mostly become a special-teams player. The move likely clears a roster spot for starter DeShon Elliott to return from injured reserve. Jenkins was on a one-year deal worth about $1.3 million.

moves.head: Rams sign veteran K Brandon McManus after Blake Grupe's ACL tear
moves.plain: The Rams lost kicker Blake Grupe to a torn ACL, so they worked out Brandon McManus and Matt Prater and chose McManus. It is their third kicker in about two weeks. His deal is expected to be a veteran-minimum contract.

moves.head: Falcons poach edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice
moves.plain: Atlanta signed edge rusher Charles Snowden to its active roster from Washington's practice squad. To make room, it is waiving Bralen Trice, who could return to the practice squad if he clears waivers.

moves.head: Winless Dolphins cut K Riley Patterson and CB Storm Duck and bring back Zane Gonzalez
moves.plain: Miami is 0-5 and releasing kicker Riley Patterson after early misses. Zane Gonzalez returns on a practice-squad deal to kick, and Justin Tucker also worked out for the team. Patterson was on a one-year, $1.4M deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs little. Cornerback Storm Duck, who started the year on PUP, goes to waivers.

moves.head: Tuesday roster churn: Eagles waive two RBs, 49ers cut Naquan Jones, Cowboys waive Caelen Carson
moves.plain: The Eagles waived RB Jaydon Blue and RB Carson Steele (Steele with an injury designation). The 49ers released DT Naquan Jones, and the Cowboys waived CB Caelen Carson to promote S Juanyeh Thomas from the practice squad. Along with Davante Adams, the Rams also put DT Poona Ford on IR.

moves.head: Titans release DT Jordan Elliott after an off-field incident
moves.plain: The release follows an incident on Oct 15. His two-year, $8M deal had $3.24M guaranteed at signing. Guaranteed money is owed even after a cut, so expect some of it to show up as dead money.

moves.head: Giants cut RB Najee Harris as teams reshuffle their rosters
moves.plain: Harris was on a veteran-minimum deal with no guaranteed money, so cutting him costs the Giants almost nothing. The Falcons added edge rusher Charles Snowden from the Commanders' practice squad and cut Bralen Trice. The Dolphins swapped kickers and waived CB Storm Duck.

moves.head: Texans get WR Marvin Harrison Jr. from the Cardinals
moves.plain: Arizona gets Houston's 2027 second-round and sixth-round picks and also sends a 2027 seventh to Houston, per the Cardinals' announcement. Harrison now counts on Houston's cap.

moves.head: Texans restructure backup QB Davis Mills' contract to free $2.7M in cap space
moves.plain: Houston cut Mills' salary to the $1.2M minimum and turned $3.7M into a signing bonus spread over five years, adding four void years, KPRC2's Aaron Wilson reports. That drops his 2026 cap hit from $8.1M to $5.4M. It is an accounting move for a team short on cap room; Mills is still set to be a free agent after this season.

moves.head: More October moves: Falcons extend Gervon Dexter, Eagles cut Andy Dalton
moves.plain: Atlanta extended DL Gervon Dexter. Philadelphia released QB Andy Dalton, and right tackle Lane Johnson is retiring. New England put WR Romeo Doubs on injured reserve, and Pittsburgh added WR Marquez Valdes-Scantling to its practice squad. The terms were not in the report.

moves.head: Ravens get center Cam Jurgens from the Eagles
moves.plain: Philadelphia gets a 2027 fifth-round pick and a 2028 second and also sends a 2027 seventh to Baltimore. The Eagles still carry about $4.6M of his old bonus as dead money.

moves.head: Cowboys get CB Joey Porter Jr. from the Steelers
moves.plain: Contract talks stalled. Porter reportedly wanted about $30M a year and Pittsburgh would not go past the high $20Ms in new money. The Steelers get a 2027 sixth and a 2028 second.

moves.head: Giants get QB J.J. McCarthy from the Vikings
moves.plain: Minnesota gets a 2027 fifth-round pick. McCarthy is still on his rookie deal; the Vikings keep about $5.1M of dead money from it.
